_note: Chapter 10 词汇卡内容。ipa = 音标; ex = 例句数组, 顺序与词表中该词出现的行序一致(多词性词给多个例句, 每个例句对应词性行); note = 用法提示/搭配。

ex.en: His absence from the meeting annoyed everyone.
ex.cn: 他缺席会议让所有人都很不高兴。
ex.note: in the absence of 在…不在场时；an absence from 缺席

ex.en: A colleague accused her of taking credit for his work.
ex.cn: 一位同事指责她抢了自己的功劳。
ex.note: accuse sb. of sth. 指控某人做某事

ex.en: The university administration refused to comment on the report.
ex.cn: 校方拒绝就这份报告发表评论。
ex.note: university administration 校方；学校管理层

ex.en: Let us move on to the next item on the agenda.
ex.cn: 我们进入议程的下一项吧。
ex.note: on the agenda 列在议程上；a hidden agenda 隐藏的意图

ex.en: She not only repaired the pump but also wrote a report on it.
ex.cn: 她不但修好了水泵，还为它写了一份报告。
ex.note: not only … but also 不但…而且

ex.en: Farm animals need clean water just as much as people do.
ex.cn: 农场里的牲畜和人一样都需要干净的水。
ex.note: wild animal 野生动物；animal rights 动物权利

ex.en: The long walk had given him a huge appetite.
ex.cn: 走了那么远的路，他胃口大开。
ex.note: a healthy appetite 食欲好；whet the appetite 吊起胃口

ex.en: Her question aroused a lively discussion in the classroom.
ex.cn: 她的问题在教室里引起了热烈的讨论。
ex.note: arouse interest 引起兴趣；arouse suspicion 引起怀疑

ex.en: Do not assume that the task is easy just because it sounds simple.
ex.cn: 别因为听起来简单，就以为这活儿很容易。
ex.note: assume responsibility 承担责任；assume that … 假定…

ex.en: The garage door opens automatically when you walk towards it.
ex.cn: 当你朝车库门走去时，它会自动打开。
ex.note: automatic control 自动控制；automatic transmission 自动变速器

ex.en: The library bans eating and drinking in the reading room.
ex.cn: 图书馆禁止在阅览室吃东西、喝饮料。
ex.note: ban sth. 禁止某事；be banned from doing 被禁止做；a total ban on 全面禁止

ex.en: The fight between the two classes turned into a famous battle.
ex.cn: 两个班之间的冲突变成了一场著名的较量。
ex.note: the battle against 与…的斗争；a losing battle 必败的斗争

ex.en: For months she battled against a fever that would not break.
ex.cn: 几个月来，她一直和一场迟迟不退的发热作斗争。
ex.note: battle with / against 与…斗争

ex.en: I believe we can finish the work before Friday.
ex.cn: 我相信我们能在周五之前把活儿干完。
ex.note: believe in 信任；believe sb. to do 相信某人会做

ex.en: They bought a small cake for her eighteenth birthday.
ex.cn: 他们为她的十八岁生日买了一个小蛋糕。
ex.note: happy birthday 生日快乐；birthday party 生日聚会

ex.en: He tightened the loose bolt with a small wrench.
ex.cn: 他用一把小扳手拧紧了松动的螺栓。
ex.note: a bolt from the blue 晴天霹雳；bolt the door 闩上门

ex.en: It was brave of him to admit the mistake in front of everyone.
ex.cn: 他敢在所有人面前承认错误，真够勇敢的。
ex.note: brave enough to do 勇敢到敢于做…

ex.en: The bulk of the work was done by two students.
ex.cn: 大部分工作是两个学生完成的。
ex.note: the bulk of 大部分；in bulk 大量地

ex.en: Mark the date of the exam in your calendar.
ex.cn: 把考试的日期在日历上标出来。
ex.note: on the calendar 日历上；calendar year 日历年

ex.en: A carpenter was hired to repair the broken shelves.
ex.cn: 他们请了一位木匠来修坏掉的架子。
ex.note: a carpenter's shop 木匠铺

ex.en: The floor of the workshop was covered with grey cement.
ex.cn: 工棚的地面覆盖着灰色的水泥。
ex.note: cement mixer 水泥搅拌机；as firm as cement 顽固如水泥

ex.en: They sat on the steps and chatted about the fair.
ex.cn: 他们坐在台阶上聊着科技节的事。
ex.note: chat with sb. 与某人闲聊；have a chat 聊聊天

ex.en: A chorus of children's voices greeted the visitors.
ex.cn: 孩子们的声音汇成一片，向来访者问好。
ex.note: a chorus of 一片…声；in chorus 齐声地

ex.en: It was a clever solution that nobody had thought of.
ex.cn: 那是个没人想到的巧妙的办法。
ex.note: clever at 擅长于；too clever by half 聪明过头

ex.en: I asked a colleague in the engineering department for advice.
ex.cn: 我向工程系的一位同事请教。
ex.note: a colleague of … …的同事

ex.en: The new library serves the whole community.
ex.cn: 这座新图书馆服务于整个社区。
ex.note: the local community 当地社区；serve the community 服务社区

ex.en: The readings are sent to a small computer in the corner.
ex.cn: 读数被传送到角落里那台小计算机。
ex.note: computer science 计算机科学；computer model 计算机模型

ex.en: Connect the red wire to the positive terminal.
ex.cn: 把红线接到正极接线柱上。
ex.note: connect A to / with B 把A与B连接起来

ex.en: The book compares ancient farming with contemporary methods.
ex.cn: 这本书把古代的耕作方式与当代方法作了比较。
ex.note: contemporary art 当代艺术；contemporary society 当代社会

ex.en: His poems are still read by young contemporaries today.
ex.cn: 他的诗如今仍被年轻的同代人传读。
ex.note: a contemporary of … 与…同时代的人

ex.en: Please make a copy of the report for the committee.
ex.cn: 请给委员会复印一份报告。
ex.note: a copy of … …的副本；make a copy 复印

ex.en: The shop was accused of copying the design from a foreign brand.
ex.cn: 那家店被指控抄袭了一家外国品牌的设计。
ex.note: copy sth. from sb. 抄袭；copy down 抄下

ex.en: They played the final on the school court.
ex.cn: 他们在学校球场上打了决赛。
ex.note: a tennis court 网球场；in court 在法庭上

ex.en: Look both ways before you cross the road.
ex.cn: 过马路前先看两边。
ex.note: cross over 穿过；cross one's fingers 交叉手指

ex.en: He drew a cross in the box to mark his choice.
ex.cn: 他在方框里画了一个十字，标出自己的选择。
ex.note: make a cross 画十字

ex.en: He was still cross about the change in the schedule.
ex.cn: 他还是因为日程变动而满心不痛快。
ex.note: be cross with / about 对…生气

ex.en: Use the scissors to cut the wire into two equal pieces.
ex.cn: 用剪刀把铁丝剪成两段一样长的。
ex.note: cut down 砍倒；cut off 切断；cut costs 削减成本

ex.en: He made a deep cut on his arm while working.
ex.cn: 干活时他胳膊上割了一道很深的口子。
ex.note: a deep cut 深深的切口；a cut in price 降价

ex.en: The death of half the seedlings made them stop for the day.
ex.cn: 一半的苗死掉了，这让他们当天就停了下来。
ex.note: the death of … …的死亡；put to death 处死

ex.en: The temperature reached thirty-eight degrees in the greenhouse.
ex.cn: 温室里的温度达到了三十八度。
ex.note: a degree of … 某种程度；Master's degree 硕士学位

ex.en: Very little plant can live in a real desert.
ex.cn: 在真正的沙漠里，几乎没有植物能存活。
ex.note: in the desert 在沙漠中

ex.en: The soldiers deserted the camp and walked home.
ex.cn: 士兵们弃营出走，回了家。
ex.note: desert one's family 抛弃家人

ex.en: A diamond in a glass case stood near the entrance.
ex.cn: 入口附近有一个玻璃展柜，里面立着一颗钻石。
ex.note: diamond-shaped 菱形的

ex.en: I disagree with you on this point.
ex.cn: 在这一点上我不同意你的看法。
ex.note: disagree with 与…意见不一；disagree to do 不同意做

ex.en: She won the highest distinction for her design.
ex.cn: 她的设计赢得了最高荣誉。
ex.note: with distinction 以杰出的成绩；make a distinction between 区分

ex.en: A poster announcing the fair appeared in every dormitory.
ex.cn: 每个宿舍里都出现了宣布科技节的海报。
ex.note: live in the dormitory 住宿舍

ex.en: The worst drought in nineteen years left the fields bare.
ex.cn: 十九年来最严重的一次旱灾让田地颗粒无收。
ex.note: a severe drought 严重干旱

ex.en: They walked to the east side of the campus before dark.
ex.cn: 天黑之前，他们走到了校园的东边。
ex.note: the east 东方；east of … 在…以东

ex.en: He hit his elbow on the edge of the desk.
ex.cn: 他胳膊肘撞到了桌沿上。
ex.note: at one's elbow 就在手边；elbow grease 苦干

ex.en: The teacher emphasized the importance of checking the figures.
ex.cn: 老师强调了核对数据的重要性。
ex.note: emphasize doing 强调要做…；put emphasis on 强调

ex.en: The old men entertained the guests with stories of the past.
ex.cn: 老人们用旧日的故事招待客人。
ex.note: entertain sb. with sth. 用…招待某人；entertain an idea 考虑一个想法

ex.en: On the eve of the exam, the library was packed.
ex.cn: 考试前夕，图书馆里挤满了人。
ex.note: on the eve of 在…前夕

ex.en: She exchanged a few words with the guard at the door.
ex.cn: 她在门口和工作人员交换了几句话。
ex.note: exchange A for B 用A换B；exchange glances 交换眼神；an exchange of ideas 交换想法

ex.en: This port exports tea and timber to twenty countries.
ex.cn: 这个港口向二十个国家出口茶叶和木材。
ex.note: export sth. to … 向…出口；the export of fruit 水果的出口

ex.en: The old dog stayed faithful to his master for fifteen years.
ex.cn: 那条老狗十五年来始终对主人忠诚。
ex.note: faithful to 对…忠诚；be faithful to the original 忠于原作

ex.en: Could you do me a favor and hold my place in the queue?
ex.cn: 能帮我个忙，替我排着队吗？
ex.note: do sb. a favor 帮某人一个忙；in favor of 赞成

ex.en: Most of the judges favored the simplest design.
ex.cn: 多数评委都偏爱最简单的设计。
ex.note: favor A over B 更喜欢A而不是B；favor the idea 赞成这个想法

ex.en: A fifth of the plants died in the first trial.
ex.cn: 第一次试验中有五分之一的植物死了。
ex.note: one fifth 五分之一；the fifth day 第五天

ex.en: This soup has a strong flavor of garlic.
ex.cn: 这汤有一股很重的蒜味。
ex.note: a flavor of 一股…味；add flavor to 给…增添风味

ex.en: We heard footsteps on the stairs in the middle of the night.
ex.cn: 半夜我们听见楼梯上有脚步声。
ex.note: heavy footsteps 沉重的脚步声；follow in sb.'s footsteps 步其后尘

ex.en: Each speaker was given fourteen minutes to present the project.
ex.cn: 每位发言者有十四分钟来展示项目。
ex.note: fourteen days 十四天

ex.en: The tray was full of young green plants.
ex.cn: 那盘子里满满当当都是青翠的小苗。
ex.note: be full of 充满；full of energy 精力充沛

ex.en: The mayor's gaze moved slowly across the hall.
ex.cn: 市长的目光缓缓扫过整个大厅。
ex.note: gaze at 凝视；a gaze of … 充满…的目光

ex.en: Winning the prize brought them a moment of glory.
ex.cn: 获奖给了他们片刻的荣光。
ex.note: in one's glory 得意洋洋；the glory of doing sth. 做某事的光荣

ex.en: She checked the grammar of the report before the meeting.
ex.cn: 开会前她检查了一遍报告的语法。
ex.note: a grammar book 语法书；grammar mistakes 语法错误

ex.en: The seller guaranteed a full refund if the machine failed.
ex.cn: 卖方保证机器出故障就全额退款。
ex.note: guarantee sb. sth. 保证某人某事；be guaranteed to do 保证会做

ex.en: A written guarantee of the parts was included in the box.
ex.cn: 盒子里附有一份零件的书面保修单。
ex.note: a guarantee against … 针对…的保证；under guarantee 在保修期内

ex.en: They hang the design on the wall before the judges arrive.
ex.cn: 他们在评委到来之前把设计图挂在墙上。
ex.note: hang up 挂上；hang out 闲逛；be hung up on 对…耿耿于怀

ex.en: A heap of old machines filled one corner of the workshop.
ex.cn: 一堆旧机器塞满了工棚的一个角落。
ex.note: a heap of 一堆；in heaps 成堆地

ex.en: They heaped the old chairs into the corner of the room.
ex.cn: 他们把旧椅子堆在房间的角落里。
ex.note: heap sth. up 堆起；heap praise on 极力称赞

ex.en: The speaker highlighted the low cost of the device.
ex.cn: 发言者突出了这台装置成本低廉这一点。
ex.note: highlight the problem 突出重点问题

ex.en: The highlight of the evening was the award ceremony.
ex.cn: 那天晚上最精彩的一刻是颁奖典礼。
ex.note: the highlight of … …中最精彩的部分

ex.en: The doctor was hopeful about her chances of recovery.
ex.cn: 医生对她的康复前景抱有信心。
ex.note: be hopeful about 对…抱有希望

ex.en: They hunted for spare parts in the workshop all morning.
ex.cn: 他们整个上午都在工棚里寻找备用零件。
ex.note: hunt for 搜寻；hunt a job 找工作；a treasure hunt 寻宝

ex.en: The immediate result of the change was a flood of complaints.
ex.cn: 这项改动带来的直接结果是一连串抱怨。
ex.note: immediate action 立即行动；in the immediate future 在最近的将来

ex.en: It seemed incredible that the whole town had come to watch.
ex.cn: 全镇的人都来看，这似乎难以置信。
ex.note: incredible speed 难以置信的速度

ex.en: Two workers were injured when the machine exploded.
ex.cn: 机器爆炸时，两名工人受了伤。
ex.note: injure sb. 伤害某人；be seriously injured 受了重伤

ex.en: He is known for his intellectual curiosity rather than for his grades.
ex.cn: 让他出名的是智识上的好奇心，而不是他的成绩。
ex.note: intellectual development 智力发展；intellectual freedom 思想自由

ex.en: A thin-faced intellectual asked the first difficult question.
ex.cn: 一位清瘦的知识分子抛出了第一个难题。
ex.note: an intellectual 知识分子；the intellectual circle 知识界

ex.en: The whole project was an investment of only five hundred yuan.
ex.cn: 整个项目的投入只有五百元。
ex.note: a wise investment 明智的投资；investment in education 教育投入

ex.en: He told a joke that made the whole room laugh.
ex.cn: 他讲了个笑话，逗得满屋子的人都笑了起来。
ex.note: tell a joke 讲笑话；be a joke 是个玩笑

ex.en: They joked about the broken pump until the tension was gone.
ex.cn: 他们拿坏掉的水泵开玩笑，直到紧张感消失。
ex.note: joke with sb. 和某人开玩笑；be joking 开玩笑而已

ex.en: She remembered the kindness of a stranger who gave her directions.
ex.cn: 她记得那个给她指路的陌生人的善意。
ex.note: do sth. as a kindness 出于好意做某事；a kindness to sb. 对某人的善意

ex.en: The market for such machines is surprisingly large.
ex.cn: 这类机器的市场大得出人意料。
ex.note: a large number of 大量的；at large 逍遥法外

ex.en: He learned a great deal about engineering from that project.
ex.cn: 那个项目让他学到了大量工程学知识。
ex.note: lifelong learning 终身学习；a learning experience 一段学习经历

ex.en: He said that day would stay with him for a lifetime.
ex.cn: 他说那一天会陪伴他一生。
ex.note: for a lifetime 一辈子；a lifetime achievement 一生的成就

ex.en: The lobby of the museum was full of visitors on opening day.
ex.cn: 开幕那天，博物馆的大厅里挤满了参观者。
ex.note: in the lobby 在大厅里；hotel lobby 酒店大堂

ex.en: My luggage is too heavy to carry up the stairs.
ex.cn: 我的行李太重了，搬不上楼梯。
ex.note: a piece of luggage 一件行李；luggage claim 行李领取处

ex.en: Clean water is something the whole of mankind depends on.
ex.cn: 干净的水是整个人类都依赖的东西。
ex.note: for the benefit of mankind 为了全人类的利益

ex.en: The mayor opened the ceremony with a short speech.
ex.cn: 市长用一段简短的讲话为典礼揭幕。
ex.note: the mayor of … …的市长；deputy mayor 副市长

ex.en: The device costs a mere five hundred yuan.
ex.cn: 这台装置只花五百元。
ex.note: mere nothing 微不足道；a mere formality 纯粹是形式

ex.en: It took a minute to find the loose connection.
ex.cn: 找到那个松动的地方只用了一分钟。
ex.note: in a minute 一会儿；the minute that 一旦

ex.en: The engineer made a minute examination of the soil samples.
ex.cn: 工程师对土壤样本做了细致的检查。
ex.note: minute details 细微的细节；a minute examination 细致的检查

ex.en: The mood in the lab stayed low for two whole days.
ex.cn: 实验室里的情绪一连两天都很低落。
ex.note: be in a good mood 心情好；change the mood 改变气氛

ex.en: The city museum hosted the science fair that year.
ex.cn: 那一年，市博物馆举办了科技节。
ex.note: a history museum 历史博物馆；a museum of science 科学馆

ex.en: A stamped form was necessary before the money could be released.
ex.cn: 在资金拨付之前，必须有一张盖了章的表格。
ex.note: It is necessary for sb. to do 某人做某事是必要的

ex.en: Nineteen teams entered the competition.
ex.cn: 共有十九支队伍参加了比赛。
ex.note: nineteen years ago 十九年前

ex.en: The pump is running smoothly now.
ex.cn: 水泵现在运行得很平稳。
ex.note: right now 立刻；now and then 时不时

ex.en: The cold ocean wind woke him up completely.
ex.cn: 冰冷的海风让他彻底清醒了。
ex.note: the open ocean 茫茫大海；ocean wind 海风

ex.en: The machine needed no operator once it had been installed.
ex.cn: 装好之后，这台机器就不需要操作员了。
ex.note: machine operator 机器操作员；tour operator 旅游经营者

ex.en: The water went out through a hole in the tube.
ex.cn: 水从软管上的一个洞里漏了出去。
ex.note: out of 在…之外；get out of 摆脱

ex.en: He carried a package of spare parts in his bag.
ex.cn: 他包里装着一包备用零件。
ex.note: a package of 一包；a package deal 一揽子交易

ex.en: Students from every department were able to participate in the fair.
ex.cn: 各个院系的学生都可以参加科技节。
ex.note: participate in 参加；actively participate 积极参与

ex.en: They ordered a plate of peanuts and a pot of tea.
ex.cn: 他们点了一盘花生和一壶茶。
ex.note: peanut butter 花生酱；roasted peanuts 烤花生

ex.en: The personnel department explained how to fill in the forms.
ex.cn: 人事处讲解了这些表格该怎么填写。
ex.note: personnel department 人事部门；military personnel 军事人员

ex.en: The pilot announced that the flight would be delayed by an hour.
ex.cn: 机长宣布航班将延误一小时。
ex.note: a pilot project 试点项目

ex.en: The university piloted the new system in two departments first.
ex.cn: 大学先在两个系里试行这套新系统。
ex.note: pilot a scheme 试行一项计划

ex.en: The price includes the pump plus a year's warranty.
ex.cn: 这个价格包含水泵，再加上一年的保修。
ex.note: plus 加；A plus B A加B

ex.en: The judges gave the team a plus for its simple, cheap design.
ex.cn: 评委们给这个团队加了一分，因为它的设计又简单又便宜。
ex.note: a plus 优点；plus point 加分项

ex.en: We needed a portable pump that could run on a battery.
ex.cn: 我们需要一台能用电池的便携式水泵。
ex.note: a portable computer 便携式电脑；a portable heater 取暖器

ex.en: Many people prayed for rain during the drought.
ex.cn: 旱灾期间，许多人祈求下雨。
ex.note: pray for 为…祈祷；pray that … 祈祷…

ex.en: Our prime concern was the safety of the pump.
ex.cn: 我们首要关心的是水泵的安全。
ex.note: a prime example 典型的例子；of prime importance 至关重要

ex.en: The grass was green and in its prime after the rain.
ex.cn: 雨后那草绿油油的，正处于最繁茂的时节。
ex.note: in the prime of life 年富力强；the prime of the season 最好的时节

ex.en: There was progress, though it was slow and uneven.
ex.cn: 确有进展，只是缓慢而不均衡。
ex.note: make progress 取得进展；a progress report 进度报告

ex.en: The team progressed slowly through the winter months.
ex.cn: 整个冬天，团队缓慢地推进着。
ex.note: progress towards 朝…进展

ex.en: They went to a pub near the museum for a quiet drink.
ex.cn: 他们去博物馆附近的一家酒吧喝了一杯。
ex.note: go to the pub 去酒吧；a local pub 当地小酒馆

ex.en: We stood in a queue at the entrance for twenty minutes.
ex.cn: 我们在入口处排了二十分钟的队。
ex.note: a queue of people 一队人；in a queue 排队

ex.en: Students queued along the wall to get their tickets checked.
ex.cn: 学生们沿着墙排成队等着验票。
ex.note: queue up 排队；queue for 排队等

ex.en: Any rational person can see that the idea is not new.
ex.cn: 任何有理性的人都能看出这个点子并不新鲜。
ex.note: a rational decision 理性的决定；a rational explanation 合理的解释

ex.en: The professor wrote them a recommendation for the national competition.
ex.cn: 教授为他们的全国大赛写了一封推荐信。
ex.note: a letter of recommendation 推荐信；on the recommendation of 根据…的推荐

ex.en: The walls were reinforced with steel bars to withstand the quake.
ex.cn: 墙体用钢筋加固，以承受地震。
ex.note: reinforce an idea 强调观点；reinforce a point 强化论点

ex.en: She had warned them repeatedly, but nobody listened.
ex.cn: 她已经反复提醒过他们，可没人听。
ex.note: repeatedly remind 反复提醒

ex.en: Nobody responded to the notice on the board.
ex.cn: 看板上贴的通知没有人回应。
ex.note: respond to 回应；respond to treatment 对治疗有反应

ex.en: It would be ridiculous to spend that much on a broken pump.
ex.cn: 把这么多钱花在一台坏水泵上太荒唐了。
ex.note: look ridiculous 看起来可笑；a ridiculous price 荒唐的价格

ex.en: They followed the route marked on the map to the museum.
ex.cn: 他们沿着地图上标出的路线前往博物馆。
ex.note: the shortest route 最短的路线；a bus route 公交线路

ex.en: A salesman offered them a special model at twice the price.
ex.cn: 一个推销员向他们推销一款特价型号，价格是原来的两倍。
ex.note: a door-to-door salesman 上门推销员

ex.en: The irrigation scheme was designed to help the whole village.
ex.cn: 这套灌溉方案是为帮助整个村庄而设计的。
ex.note: a colour scheme 配色方案；a pension scheme 养老金计划

ex.en: The two teams schemed to take the prize without doing any work.
ex.cn: 两个小组密谋着不费力气就把奖拿到手。
ex.note: scheme to do 密谋做某事；scheme against 密谋反对

ex.en: A security guard checked the tickets at the entrance.
ex.cn: 一名保安在入口处查验门票。
ex.note: security guard 保安；public security 公共安全；security forces 安全部队

ex.en: The settings on the device can be adjusted by hand.
ex.cn: 装置上的参数可以手动调节。
ex.note: the setting sun 落日；adjust the settings 调节设置

ex.en: His shirt was soaked through with water and oil.
ex.cn: 他的衬衫被水和机油浸得透湿。
ex.note: a dress shirt 衬衫；shirt sleeves 衬衫袖子

ex.en: There was a significant rise in the number of applicants.
ex.cn: 申请人数显著上升。
ex.note: a significant difference 显著差异；significant figures 有效数字

ex.en: The company is looking for skilled workers to join the team.
ex.cn: 公司正在招揽有技术的工人加入团队。
ex.note: skilled in 熟练掌握；highly skilled 技术娴熟的

ex.en: The tea tasted so strange that nobody said a word.
ex.cn: 茶的味道那么古怪，竟没有一个人开口。
ex.note: so + adj. 如此；not so much … as 与其说…不如说

ex.en: It was raining hard, so they stayed indoors.
ex.cn: 雨下得很大，所以他们待在屋里。
ex.note: so that 以便；so … as to 以便能够

ex.en: The students sang an old song at the end of the term.
ex.cn: 学期末，学生们唱了一首老歌。
ex.note: a folk song 民歌；sing a song 唱歌

ex.en: They tested the machine on soil specimens from three fields.
ex.cn: 他们用来自三块田地的土壤样本测试这台机器。
ex.note: a blood specimen 血样；a specimen of one's work 作品的样本

ex.en: He squeezed the tube to force out the last of the water.
ex.cn: 他捏了捏软管，把最后一点水挤了出来。
ex.note: squeeze out 挤出；squeeze in 挤进去

ex.en: There was a fierce squeeze for a place on the team.
ex.cn: 争夺团队名额的竞争十分激烈。
ex.note: a tight squeeze 勉为其难；put a squeeze on 对…施加压力

ex.en: She steered the boat through the narrow channel.
ex.cn: 她驾着小船穿过狭窄的水道。
ex.note: steer clear of 避开；steer sb. towards 引导某人

ex.en: A steady stream of visitors came through the door.
ex.cn: 源源不断的参观者从门口涌了进来。
ex.note: a stream of 一股（人或物）；a stream of light 一道光

ex.en: Water streamed from the broken pipe and flooded the floor.
ex.cn: 水从破裂的管子里涌出来，淹了地板。
ex.note: stream in 涌进；stream with tears 泪流满面

ex.en: Few teams succeed on their first attempt.
ex.cn: 很少有队伍第一次尝试就成功。
ex.note: succeed in doing 成功做成；succeed sb. as 继任某人

ex.en: The supermarket near the campus opens at eight every morning.
ex.cn: 校园附近的超市每天早上八点开门。
ex.note: at the supermarket 在超市

ex.en: A swift reply from the office saved them a whole week.
ex.cn: 办公室迅速的回信替他们省了一整周。
ex.note: swift action 迅速的行动；a swift response 迅速的反应

ex.en: He drank two cups of tea before the examination.
ex.cn: 考试前他喝了两杯茶。
ex.note: make tea 泡茶；a tea break 茶歇

ex.en: The weather was terrible, so the match was postponed.
ex.cn: 天气糟透了，所以比赛被推迟了。
ex.note: terrible weather 糟糕的天气；a terrible mistake 严重的错误

ex.en: The ice on the lake was too thin to walk on.
ex.cn: 湖上的冰太薄了，走上去不安全。
ex.note: thin ice 薄冰；a thin soup 清汤

ex.en: The fog thinned towards the middle of the day.
ex.cn: 到了中午前后，雾渐渐散了。
ex.note: thin out 变稀；thin down 变薄

ex.en: He bought a bus ticket for the trip to the city.
ex.cn: 他买了一张开往市里的公交车票。
ex.note: a ticket to / for … …的票；a parking ticket 罚单

ex.en: She answered in a calm tone and asked to see the manager.
ex.cn: 她用平静的语气回答，并要求见经理。
ex.note: in a … tone 以…的语气；tone of voice 声调

ex.en: The readings are transferred to the computer every ten seconds.
ex.cn: 读数每十秒传送到计算机一次。
ex.note: transfer sth. to sb. 把…转让给…；transfer money 转账

ex.en: The transfer of the samples took two days.
ex.cn: 样品的转运花了两天。
ex.note: a transfer of funds 资金转移；a transfer service 中转服务

ex.en: The team was in trouble when the pump failed twice.
ex.cn: 水泵两次出故障，团队陷入了麻烦。
ex.note: in trouble 遇到麻烦；trouble with … 在…方面有困难

ex.en: Do not trouble yourself with the packing; I will do it.
ex.cn: 打包的事不用你操心，我来弄。
ex.note: trouble sb. with sth. 用某事麻烦某人

ex.en: He was unable to lift the heavy box by himself.
ex.cn: 他没法独自抬起那个重箱子。
ex.note: be unable to do 无法做；be unable to help 束手无策

ex.en: They carried the equipment up to the third floor.
ex.cn: 他们把设备搬到了三楼。
ex.note: up and down 上上下下；up to 高达

ex.en: In the valley below, a few farmers were working in the fields.
ex.cn: 下面的山谷里，几个农民正在田里劳作。
ex.note: a river valley 河谷；in the valley of … 在…的山谷

ex.en: Anyone who violates the rules will be asked to leave.
ex.cn: 违反规定的人会被要求离开。
ex.note: violate the rules 违反规定；violate the law 违法

ex.en: She slipped her hands around his waist and held on.
ex.cn: 她双手环住他的腰，抱住了他。
ex.note: waistline 腰围；by the waist 齐腰

ex.en: The spider can weave a fine web between two branches.
ex.cn: 蜘蛛能在两根树枝间织出一张细密的网。
ex.note: weave a basket 编织篮子；weave into 织入

ex.en: She could not decide whether to accept the offer.
ex.cn: 她拿不定主意要不要接受这个提议。
ex.note: whether … or not 是否；or whether 抑或

ex.en: She wiped the table with a damp cloth.
ex.cn: 她用一块湿布擦了桌子。
ex.note: wipe off 擦掉；wipe out 消灭；wipe one's face 抹脸

ex.en: The experiment was worth every hour of work.
ex.cn: 这个实验值得付出每一小时的努力。
ex.note: be worth doing 值得做；be worth the trouble 值得麻烦

ex.en: The old radio was not worth very much money.
ex.cn: 那台旧收音机不值多少钱。
ex.note: the worth of … …的价值；for what it is worth 不管值多少

ex.en: Take care of yourself before the examination.
ex.cn: 考试之前照顾好自己。
ex.note: by yourself 独自；be yourself 放松点
